nodes.label: Project Space
nodes.rationale: Design intent: the landmark is a gated walkway with a green neon script sign over red 'TH'-shaped pillars and warm path lighting, filmed at night, marking a dedicated project/innovation zone on campus and making the space read as inviting and premium in the video thumbnail.

nodes.label: Technical Hub
nodes.rationale: Brand treatment: the wordmark sits on a deep starfield with a purple horizon gradient, a styling choice made to position Technical Hub as ambitious, futuristic and aspirational in its title cards ('Why Technical Hub' video thumbnail).

nodes.label: TH Monogram Logo
nodes.rationale: Monogram design: an orange H inside a yellow-green square frame next to a green T reads as 'TH' (Technical Hub) - a compact, high-contrast mark reusable at small sizes for signage tiles and thumbnails.
